sentences.en: An acquaintance of mine introduced me to his closest friends.
sentences.zh: 我的一位熟人把他最亲近的朋友介绍给了我。

sentences.en: Please tell me the closest station to your office.
sentences.zh: 请告诉我离你办公室最近的一站。

sentences.en: I know the boy who is sitting closest to the door.
sentences.zh: 我知道坐在门旁边的那个男孩。

phrases.zh: 我最……的（比如：我最喜爱的东西）
